antq_negotiate_route_safe_conduct = {
	icon = antq_negotiate_route_safe_conduct
	type = internationalorganization
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	automation_tick = monthly
	automation_tick_frequency = 1
	show_message_to_target = yes

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:antq_arabian_route_exchanges
		scope:actor = {
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:antq_arabian_route_exchanges
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:antq_arabian_route_exchanges
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target
		name = "choose_country"
		interaction_source_list = {
			international_organization:antq_arabian_route_exchanges = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					add_to_list = source
				}
			}
		}
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			this != scope:actor
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:antq_arabian_route_exchanges
		}
	}

	allow = {
		exists = scope:target
		scope:actor = { gold >= 10 }
		scope:target = {
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:antq_arabian_route_exchanges
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = antq_negotiate_route_safe_conduct
		years = 3
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -10
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		}
		scope:target = {
			add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = antq_opinion_route_safe_conduct }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 12 }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 20 } }
			add = { value = -30 }
		}
	}
}
